original_question: Let N be a Connes embeddable separable II1 factor. Determine whether N admits an embedding into RU whose commutant is a factor.
target_in_paper: Problem 36 in the "Miscellaneous" section, immediately preceded by the note that "The problem below is due to S. Popa": the paper asks whether a Connes embeddable separable II_1 factor admits an embedding into R^U with factorial commutant. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper very closely: it has the right object N (a Connes embeddable separable II_1 factor), the right target ultrapower R^U, and the right property to be tested, namely that the commutant of the embedded copy should be a factor. It is also scoped to exactly the same open problem rather than a broader neighboring question. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
missing_details: The paper has a standing convention that U is a nonprincipal ultrafilter on N; this should be stated explicitly in a stand-alone version. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

R should be identified as the hyperfinite II_1 factor, and R^U as its tracial ultrapower. The notation paragraph defines M^U for a tracial von Neumann algebra M. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

The relevant commutant is the relative commutant of the image of the embedding, i.e. pi(N)' ∩ R^U, not an abstract commutant of N by itself. This is what "factorial commutant" means in context. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

For full operator-algebraic precision, the embedding should be understood as a unital trace-preserving *-embedding. This is standard for embeddings between II_1 factors, though the paper states the problem tersely. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

If you want the question to reflect the paper exactly, it should be phrased as an existence/yes-no problem for every such N, rather than as a generic "determine whether" prompt. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
refined_question: Fix a nonprincipal ultrafilter U on N, let R denote the hyperfinite II_1 factor, and write R^U for its tracial ultrapower. For every separable Connes embeddable II_1 factor N, does there exist a unital trace-preserving embedding pi: N -> R^U such that the relative commutant pi(N)' ∩ R^U is a factor? ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
justification: This is the nearest official formulation in the paper: Problem 36 asks exactly for an embedding of a Connes embeddable separable II_1 factor into R^U with factorial commutant, and the surrounding standing notation supplies the missing meaning of U and of ultrapower notation. The paper does not, nearby, replace this by a broader conjecture or prove an explicit equivalent reformulation, so the sharpest faithful rewrite is just the same problem with the operator-algebraic notation made explicit. The attribution to S. Popa is part of the immediate local context. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
